description: List saved screen/video recordings (frame capture sessions), newest first, with their session IDs. Use this FIRST when you do not already have a session ID - the IDs it returns are what chromedebug_show_frames, get_frame_session_info, get_frame, get_frame_screenshot and search_frame_logs all take. Workflow and click-to-capture screenshot recordings are stored separately; list those with list_workflow_recordings. The response carries dbPath and dbFile, which describe THIS server's own database handle (ok | missing | replaced | unknown) and say nothing about other servers - an empty list with dbFile 'ok' can still mean another server holds your recordings. This tool fails rather than returning an empty list when its handle is stale.

limit.description: Maximum sessions to return (default: 50). Use 0 for no limit.

offset.description: Number of sessions to skip, for paging through a long list (default: 0).

name: list_frame_sessions
